Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic end-of-month and anniversary hype where developers release teasers rather than deliverables, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets require strict carve-outs from core strategic rules. Specific still-open markets requiring attention include ongoing monitoring of the Aug 11-14 resolution cluster IDs to detect the liquidity wave trigger.

decisions.question: Will Ukraine capture more territory than it loses to Russia in August 2026?
decisions.thinking: While analysts note Russian offensive momentum has slowed and Ukrainian strikes disrupt logistics, Black Bird Group tracking consistently shows positive Russian net monthly gains throughout 2026 (+106 sq km in July). Without a major Ukrainian counter-offensive reclaiming significant ground, Russia is highly likely to record a positive net advance in August as well. Estimating a 12% chance Ukraine nets more territory.
decisions.uncertainty: Whether Ukraine conducts a large-scale territorial counter-offensive in late August that nets substantial recaptured land.
decisions.resolution_risk: If Black Bird Group fails to publish the August report by October 1, 2026, the market resolves N/A.
evidence_for: Defense analysts like Mike Kofman assess Ukraine has gained operational initiative on the battlefield.
Ukrainian strike campaigns against Russian refining and logistics infrastructure have created fuel shortages for Russian units.
